english: A complex system can be hard to read in one diagram.
chinese: 复杂系统很难在一张图中清楚呈现。

english: Keep the overview clear.
chinese: 让概览保持清晰。

english: Open a component when you need more detail.
chinese: 需要更多细节时，再展开组件。

english: This is the Transformer example in Archify Labs.
chinese: 这是 Archify Labs 中的 Transformer 示例。

english: Select Transformer Layer and open its internal architecture.
chinese: 选择 Transformer Layer，然后打开内部架构。

english: The child expands below the main diagram.
chinese: 子图在主图下方展开。

english: Its local components have their own Semantic Passport.
chinese: 局部组件有各自的 Semantic Passport。

english: The Export menu offers two targets.
chinese: Export 菜单提供两个导出目标。

english: Main diagram exports the overview.
chinese: Main diagram 导出主图概览。

english: Current subarchitecture exports only the open child.
chinese: Current subarchitecture 只导出当前子图。

english: This child SVG contains seven local components.
chinese: 这张子图 SVG 仅包含七个局部组件。

english: The two exports stay independent.
chinese: 两种导出彼此独立。

english: Use Back to model to return.
chinese: 点击 Back to model 返回。

english: The page restores your scroll position and parent selection.
chinese: 页面恢复原来的滚动位置和父组件选择。

english: Larger children can scroll.
chinese: 较大的子图可以滚动查看。

english: The main diagram keeps its original behavior.
chinese: 主图保留原有行为。

english: The BAGEL example follows the official inference code.
chinese: BAGEL 示例依据官方推理代码绘制。

english: Open context assembly to inspect text, vision, and VAE paths.
chinese: 展开上下文组装，查看文本、视觉和 VAE 路径。

english: Open the MoT layer to see attention and separate feed-forward paths.
chinese: 展开 MoT 层，查看注意力和分别处理的前馈路径。

english: Source links point to a fixed repository revision.
chinese: 源码链接指向固定的仓库版本。

english: The Lance example follows a dataset query.
chinese: Lance 示例展示数据集查询路径。

english: Open the scanner to inspect its query plan.
chinese: 展开 Scanner，查看查询计划。

english: Some stages depend on the query options.
chinese: 部分阶段由查询选项决定。

english: Then open the Arrow stream bridge.
chinese: 再展开 Arrow 数据流桥接层。

english: See how Rust batches reach Python.
chinese: 查看 Rust 中的批次如何传到 Python。

english: These views are optional additions in Labs.
chinese: 这些视图是 Labs 中的可选增量功能。

english: Each child stays one level deep with up to twelve components.
chinese: 子图仅支持一层，最多包含十二个组件。

english: Try Transformer, BAGEL, and Lance in the gallery.
chinese: 在 Gallery 中体验 Transformer、BAGEL 和 Lance。

english: Bring a real diagram and share what you find.
chinese: 欢迎用真实架构图试用，并分享你的发现。
